scientific_integrity: Complete exact integer finite-case checker accompanies the proof; finite checks are not used as infinite proofs. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The best universal 1/2 factor is attained only in a limit of integer-set examples; no optimality is claimed for the restriction to prime sets, nor is the sufficient gap threshold 2M asserted necessary. The qualitative distinct-prime partition theorem was proved previously. Historical priority is qualified pending independent literature review.
title: Sharp split-product inequality and a prime-gap threshold
